paite: Huan Saul in atapa Jonathan leh asikha tengteng kiang ah David thah ding thu agen hi.
heading: Saul In David Asawi
english: Saul spoke to Jonathan his son and to all his servants, that they should kill David. But Jonathan, Saul’s son, greatly delighted in David.

paite: Himahleh Saul tapa Jonathan in David adeihthoh mahmah hi. Jonathan in, "Ka pa Saul in thah ding in hon zong hi, huaiziak in, zingchiang zingsang in pilvang inla mun-guk ah bu nilouh in.
english: Jonathan told David, saying, “Saul my father seeks to kill you. Now therefore, please take care of yourself in the morning, live in a secret place, and hide yourself.

paite: Ka pawtkhe dia, na omna gamlak ah ka pa kiang ah ka va dingh dia, na tungtang thu ah ka pa ka houpih ding. Huchi in ka muhdan ka hon hilh ding," achi hi.
english: I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where you are, and I will talk with my father about you; and if I see anything, I will tell you.”

paite: Jonathan in apa Saul ma ah David aphat a, akiang ah, "Asikha David tung ah kumpipa khial het kei hen. Na tung ah lah akhial kei a, athilhihte lah nang a dia hoih pipi ahi zaw ngal ua.
english: Jonathan spoke good of David to Saul his father, and said to him, “Don’t let the king sin against his servant, against David; because he has not sinned against you, and because his works have been very good toward you;

paite: Sih khawk sa lou in Philistia mi asual a, TOUPA'N Israel tengteng a ding in hotdamna thupitak asepkhiaksak hi. Huai nang ngei in na mu a, na kipak mahmah hi. Huaiziak in sisan poi khoih lou tung ah bang ding in ahia na khelh ding, aziak bangmah om lou a David na thah ding?" achi hi.
english: for he put his life in his hand and struck the Philistine, and Yahweh worked a great victory for all Israel. You saw it and rejoiced. Why then will you sin against innocent blood, to kill David without a cause?”

paite: Huchi in Saul in Jonathan thugen azui hi. Saul in kichiam in, "TOUPA ahin lai teng amah thah ahi kei ding," achi hi.
english: Saul listened to the voice of Jonathan; and Saul swore, “As Yahweh lives, he shall not be put to death.”

paite: Jonathan in David asam a, huai thil tengteng ahilh hi. Jonathan in Saul kiang ah David api a, tuma lam mah bang in akiang ah a-om nawnta hi.
english: Jonathan called David, and Jonathan showed him all those things. Then Jonathan brought David to Saul, and he was in his presence as before.

paite: Kidouna ahong om nawn a, David akuankhia hi. Philistia mite ava sual a, tamtak ava that a, ama ah ataikek uhi.
english: There was war again. David went out and fought with the Philistines, and killed them with a great slaughter; and they fled before him.

paite: Saul bel a-inn a teipi tawi a, atut lai in atung ah TOUPA sawl kha gilou ahong tung hi. David in kaihging atum hi.
english: An evil spirit from Yahweh was on Saul as he sat in his house with his spear in his hand; and David was playing music with his hand.

paite: Saul in ateipi in David baang toh khohden atum hi. Himahleh Saul kiang a pan akitholhkhe geih a, teipi pen baang ah akhohtal hi. Huchi in David ataikhia a, huai zan in asuakta hi.
english: Saul sought to pin David to the wall with the spear, but he slipped away out of Saul’s presence; and he stuck the spear into the wall. David fled and escaped that night.

paite: Saul in azingsang a David tang a that ding in mi asawl hi. David zi Mikal in, tuzan a na hinna na humbit keileh zingchiang in hon that ding uh, chi in ahilh hi.
english: Saul sent messengers to David’s house to watch him and to kill him in the morning. Michal, David’s wife, told him, saying, “If you don’t save your life tonight, tomorrow you will be killed.”

paite: Mikal in David tohlet ah akhaikhesuk a; huchi in ataimang a, asuakta hi.
english: So Michal let David down through the window. He went away, fled, and escaped.

paite: Mikal in milim ala a, lupna ah alumsak a, alulam ah kel mul lukham akoih a, puan in akhuh hi.
english: Michal took the teraphim and laid it in the bed, and put a pillow of goats’ hair at its head and covered it with clothes.

paite: David pi dia Saul in mi ahon sawl kiang ah, "Achi ana," ana chi hi.
english: When Saul sent messengers to take David, she said, “He is sick.”

paite: Saul in David va en ding in mi asawl nawn a, "Alupna toh hon zawngtou le uchin ka na that ding," achi hi.
english: Saul sent the messengers to see David, saying, “Bring him up to me in the bed, that I may kill him.”

paite: Amisawlte ava lut uleh, ngai in, lupna ah milim alulam a kel mul lukham kham in ana om hi.
english: When the messengers came in, behold, the teraphim was in the bed, with the pillow of goats’ hair at its head.

paite: Saul in Mikal kiang ah, "Bangziak a hichibang a hon khem a, bitna dia ka melma pawtsak na hia?" achi hi. Mikal in Saul adawng a, "Hon paisak in, bangziak a nang hon that ding ka hia? ahon chi,” achi hi.
english: Saul said to Michal, “Why have you deceived me like this and let my enemy go, so that he has escaped?” Michal answered Saul, “He said to me, ‘Let me go! Why should I kill you?’”

paite: Huchi in David ataimang a, asuakta hi. Ramah a Samuel kiang ava tung a, Saul in atung a athilhih tengteng ava hilh hi. Amah leh Samuel akuan ua, Naioth ah a-om uhi.
english: Now David fled and escaped, and came to Samuel at Ramah, and told him all that Saul had done to him. He and Samuel went and lived in Naioth.

paite: Ngai in, Ramah a Naioth ah David a-om, chi in Saul ahilh uh.
english: Saul was told, saying, “Behold, David is at Naioth in Ramah.”

paite: Huchi in David pi ding in Saul in thupotu asawl hi. Zawlnei pawlte thugenkhol a a-om lai uh leh Samuel atung ua heutu a om ava muh un Saul in amisawl thupote tung ah Pathian Kha ahong tung a, amau leng thugenkhol in a-om sam uhi.
english: Saul sent messengers to seize David; and when they saw the company of the prophets prophesying, and Samuel standing as head over them, God’s Spirit came on Saul’s messengers, and they also prophesied.

paite: Huai Saul ahilh uleh, thupotu dang asawl nawn a, amau leng thugenkhol in ava om zel uhi. Saul in athumveina ding in thupotu dang asawl nawn a, amau leng thugenkhol in ava om nawn zel uhi.
english: When Saul was told, he sent other messengers, and they also prophesied. Saul sent messengers again the third time, and they also prophesied.

paite: Amah leng Ramah ah ava hoh a, Seku mun a tuileh lian mahmah ava pha hi. "Samuel leh David koi a om ahi ua?" chi in adong hi. Mi kuahiam khat in, "Ngai in, Ramah a Naioth ah a-om uh," achi hi.
english: Then he also went to Ramah, and came to the great well that is in Secu: and he asked, “Where are Samuel and David?” One said, “Behold, they are at Naioth in Ramah.”

paite: Ramah a Naioth ah ahoh a; Pathian kha atung ah ahong tung samta a, apai zel hi. Ramah a Naioth atun matan thugenkhol in a-om lai hi.
english: He went there to Naioth in Ramah. Then God’s Spirit came on him also, and he went on, and prophesied, until he came to Naioth in Ramah.

paite: Ama'n apuansilhte leng asuah a, Samuel ma ah thugenkhol in a-om a, huai ni nitum leh huai zankhua in vuaktang in alum hi. Huaiziak in "Saul leng zawlnei lak a tel sam ahi maw?" achi uhi.
english: He also stripped off his clothes. He also prophesied before Samuel and lay down naked all that day and all that night. Therefore they say, “Is Saul also among the prophets?”
